prose: Latent Space interviews Zeno Rocha, CEO of Resend, on agent experience optimization (AEO). The hook: in an AEO study, Claude Code picked Resend first in 64 of 102 email recommendations, while SendGrid came first seven times but appeared 55 times as an alternative. If a developer asks an agent to add email and accepts the suggestion, the agent's choice becomes the vendor. The episode is about designing products agents recommend.
highlights: Claude Code picked Resend first in 64 of 102 recommendations
